import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution11 {
    static boolean possible(int m, int w) {
        if (m <= 0) {
            return true;
        }
        int remainder = m % w;
        if (remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1) {
            return false;
        }
        return possible((m + 1) / w, w);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        if (w < 4) {
            System.out.println("YES");
        } else {
            System.out.println(possible(m, w) ? "YES" : "NO");
        }
    }
}
